questions.stem: A 45-year-old female presents to the clinic with a slow-growing, painless mass on her upper back that has been present for several years. The mass is soft and mobile, with a doughy texture. Physical examination reveals a 5 cm subcutaneous mass that is well-circumscribed and non-tender. There is no erythema, warmth, or fluctuance. The patient is otherwise healthy, with no other significant medical history. The clinician makes a diagnosis of lipoma. Which of the following statements would be true about the lesion on imaging?
